name: Winston
text: The architecture is sound. We layer the talking heads over a live galaxy and route each voice to its own avatar.

name: Sally
text: And it feels alive. Each agent glows and steps forward when it speaks. The cosmic stage is gorgeous.

name: John
text: Ship the smallest thing that proves the concept. This demo already does exactly that.

name: Amelia
text: It is wired to the live receiver. Real Agent Vibes messages drive these heads. It works.
